card.name: Trailing zero or 'times' in dose figures
card.fires_on: The final zero of a round number such as 10, 20, 100 or 740 inside parentheses of dose or concentration figures, and the word 'times' after a small number in dose multiples.

modes.label: Zero ending a number
modes.description: The last digit 0 completing a round number in a concentration or volume.
modes.example: 1 mL of 0.1N hydrochloric acid to 10<<0>> mL with Water for Injection, USP

modes.label: Times after a multiplier
modes.description: The word 'times' after a number when comparing a dose to the recommended dose.
modes.example: 300 mg once daily (3<< times>> and 12 times recommended daily dose

card.plain: It fires on the end of a round dose number or on 'times' in a dose multiple, such as 3 times the recommended dose.
